build_camembert_model: build a Camembert encoder model for French-language sequence representation with self-attention layers
create_masked_lm: create a Camembert masked language model for fill-in-the-blank token prediction on French text
classify_sequence: classify text sequences into categories using CamembertForSequenceClassification with a configurable number of labels
token_classification: perform token-level classification such as NER on French text using CamembertForTokenClassification
answer_question: extract answer spans from a context passage using CamembertForQuestionAnswering with start and end position logits
